Licence texts for bundled components whose Python packages do not ship one.

gsend_cad/licenses.py appends any of these it finds to THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt:

    LGPL-3.0.txt                 GNU Lesser General Public License v3 (Qt / PySide6)
                                 official text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt
    OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt      Open CASCADE Technology exception to the LGPL 2.1
                                 official text: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/blob/master/OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt

Copy the official text in unchanged. Until a file is here, the notices name the licence
and give the link above instead of the full text.
